blocks.text: CANBERRA — Australia is moving to tighten several migration rules, including restricting family members accompanying some international students and reducing the number of working holiday-makers allowed to stay for a second or third year. The proposed changes include: READ: Skilled migrant women facing barriers in Australia Why the changes? The government wants to reduce population growth driven by migration from 292,100 to 245,000 in the year to July 2027 and to 225,000 annually thereafter. Immigration Minister Tony Burke said migration was now tracking in line with the government’s targets, after population growth repeatedly exceeded Labor’s forecasts since it came to power […]...
